whatsappMessage:
Hi Team La Casa cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.3★ reviews with 965+ happy guests in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, signature menu showcase, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lacasa

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi La Casa cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (La Casa cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu showcase, and your prime location in Patliputra Colony. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
